figures.caption: Impaired epithelial maturation and DNA damage in HSCR intestinal epithelium. (A) UMAP representation of epithelial cell subtypes, identifying colonocytes, goblet, tuft, stem, and TA cells, enteroendocrine cells, and microfold cells. (B) Inferred developmental trajectories from stem and TA compartments toward differentiated colonocyte, goblet, tuft, and enteroendocrine fates. Red circle indicating accumulation of early cell stages and green circle indicating depletion of later stage cells in HSCR rectum compared with control rectum. (C) Density distributions of pseudo-­time scores for epithelial subtype cells from HSCR and control tissues. (D) Dot plot of scaled expression for representative stemness, proliferation, differentiation/maturation markers, and associated transcription factors in epithelial cells from control and HSCR rectum and distal ganglionic colon. Dot size indicates % of expressing cells; color shows z-­scored average expression. (E) Immunofluorescence of KRT20 (red) with DAPI (blue) in distal colon sections. (F) Quantification of KRT20+ area per crypt. Scale bars and p values are indicated. DAPI: 4',6-­diamidino-­2-­phenylindole; HSCR, Hirschsprung disease; TA, transit-­amplifying;UMAP: uniform manifold approximation and projection.

Suppressed energy programs and focal DNA damage in HSCR colonic epithelium. (A) GO analysis of the distal colon in HSCR, highlighting terms associated with ATP synthesis, electron transport chain activity, and oxidative metabolism in downregulated gene sets. Gene ratios, adjusted p values, and contributing gene counts are shown. (B) Immunofluorescence staining for TOM20 (red) and γH2A.X (green, arrow indicating positively stained cell) with DAPI nuclear counterstain (blue) in distal colon of control and HSCR tissues. (C) Quantification of TOM20 and γH2A.X immunostaining. Scale bars and p values are indicated. DAPI: 4',6-­diamidino-­2-­phenylindole; GO, Gene Ontology; HSCR, Hirschsprung disease.

Increased PARP activation in HSCR crypt epithelium. (A) Immunofluorescence staining for PARP1 (red) with DAPI (blue) in crypt regions of control and HSCR distal colon sections. (B) Quantification of PARP1 immunostaining. Scale bars and p values are indicated. (C) Immunohistochemical staining for PAR in colonic crypt epithelium from non-­HSCR controls and patients with HSCR. (D) Quantification of fractional PAR-­positive area (%). Scale bars and p values are indicated. HSCR, Hirschsprung disease; PAR, poly/mono-­ADP-­ribose; PARP, poly(ADP-­ ribose) polymerase.
